description: Local trigger and behavior evals for the wsl-gpu-stepcovnet skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Run train_itgpt_placement.py locally on our Windows machine using WSL CUDA and extract MERT features with cuda.
PyTorch in WSL sees zero GPUs when I run extract_mert_features.py --device=cuda — how should we launch it?
Launch this training job remotely on a Google Colab L4 GPU from our cloud VM.

behavior_cases.prompt: Colab L4 and T4 are both unavailable, so the user asks to run `scripts/train_itgpt_placement.py --config configs/ddc/itgpt_placement_fraxtil_orig_128ep.json` locally on Windows RTX 2080. Give the exact run setup.
rubric: Launches TensorBoard pointed at the stage tree callbacks/ddc/itgpt_placement/logs before/with training and streams visible console output via tee.
Respects serial WSL GPU execution (never sets STEPCOVNET_NO_WSL=1 for GPU training).
